secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API key (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps > API Key)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase Auth domain, e.g. <project-id>.firebaseapp.com (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Firebase Realtime Database URL, e.g. https://<project-id>-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com (Firebase Console > Realtime Database)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase Storage bucket, e.g. <project-id>.appspot.com (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Messaging Sender ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps > Cloud Messaging)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Web App ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps > App ID)

secrets.name: VITE_ADMIN_EMAIL
secrets.description: The admin email address that gets access to the Admin panel (your Firebase auth admin user email)

secrets.name: VITE_DB_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared AES encryption secret used by the frontend to encrypt/decrypt database values (must match the backend DB_SECRET)

secrets.name: VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (Cloudflare Dashboard > Turnstile > your widget > Site Key)

secrets.name: VITE_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key (Cloudflare Dashboard > Turnstile > your widget > Secret Key)
